title: The Last Memory: Episode 3 — The Vessel
episode_goal: Mara must escape the sealed chapel, learn her mother's true connection to Elias, and keep Elias from becoming an empty vessel.
synopsis: Trapped beneath the chapel, Mara uses the intact shard to uncover her mother's original bargain: Elena traded Elias's immortality to save Mara as a dying child. In the flooded crypt, Mara learns Elias has been carrying the final memories of the dead as a supernatural vault, and that her compassion is the payment sustaining the exchange. character_states.name: Mara Vale
character_states.motivation: To save lives without surrendering her identity or abandoning Elias.

character_states.name: Elias Voss
character_states.motivation: To recover his identity before the Pale Listener turns him into an empty vessel.

character_states.name: The Pale Listener
character_states.motivation: To erase Elias completely and collect Mara's compassion as payment.

character_states.name: Elena Vale
character_states.motivation: To protect Mara from the bargain she once made, even after betraying Elias.

final_scene_outcome: Elias recovers his name and the chapel breaks open, but the Listener enters Mara through Elena's voice and whispers that the final exchange will happen inside her body at dawn.
final_turning_point: Elias remembers Mara's name, but Mara's voice answers in Elena's voice as the Listener claims her as its new vessel.
next_episode_question: Can Mara restore Elias's stolen identity before the Pale Listener makes her mother's bargain permanent?
